newsitem.title: USA: Gray Communications stake raised by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: Gray Communications stake raised by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Tuesday it raised its stake in Gray Communications Systems Inc to 621,100 Class B common shares or 17.75 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 55,900 additional common shares bought between December 18 and December 20 at prices ranging from $15.2279 to $16.4813 per share.
The group previously held a 16.15 percent in Gray or 565,200 Class B common shares.
The Gabelli group has bought 254,100 additional common shares in Gray since it first reported its initial stake of 10.49 percent on October 7, 1996.
Gray, based in Atlanta, Georgia, owns and operates seven network-affiliated television stations in medium-sized markets in the southeastern United States.
